symbol: # Synaptogenesis gene panel for C. elegans (v4)
# References checked against Crossref and PubMed; SYNAPTOGENESIS.txt records
# which were read in full and which from the abstract.
# 13 classes spanning regulatory layer (TFs + mRNA export) -> effector
# machinery (adhesion, AZ, SV, innexins, receptors) -> signaling (Wnt, PHR/MAPK)
# v3 changes: cross-checked against 7 primary papers (Hendi 2019, Klassen 2007,
# AND against WormBase WS298 GO annotations (gene_db.sqlite). See
# SYNAPTOGENESIS.txt for per-class references and per-gene verification status.
# v4 changes: subclass is now the gene's role within its class, from a fixed
# list of 2-6 roles per class (labels in src/lib/synaptogenesis-references.ts).
# The former molecular tag moved to the family column, which the app ignores.

notes: NeuroD; motor neuron fate (Hallam 2000); RME/DD fate with ceh-5 and ceh-13 (Aquino-Nunez 2020)
Neurogenin; activates multiple terminal selectors (Christensen 2020); proneural for the MI neuron with hlh-2 (Nakano 2010)
Achaete-Scute; required for HSN motor neuron differentiation (Doonan 2008)
labial Hox; DD1/DD2 motor neuron fate with cnd-1 (Aquino-Nunez 2020)
Hes; restricts neuroblast (postdeirid) formation in the lateral epidermis (Wrischnik 1997)
Asymmetric neuroblast division; positions the cleavage plane (Frank 2005)
FoxD; generates AWA and ASG chemosensory neurons (Sarafi-Reinach 2000)
miRNA; ASE L/R asymmetry; primed embryonically then boosted via CHE-1 (Cochella & Hobert 2012)
HMX/NKX; specifies AWC sensory neuron identity via ceh-36 (Kim 2010)
Olig-related bHLH; with hlh-32 specifies AUA interneuron and VB2 motor neuron identity (Aguilar 2025)
AVG, VC, ADL, ASG, ASJ identity
Pan-neuronal regulator; ADL, AWB, BAG identity
GABAergic VC/RIS + ASE-L identity (moved from class 01)
Pax6; head sensory neuron identity (moved from class 01)
RFX; master selector for ALL ciliated sensory neurons; DAF-19A/B also maintains synaptic activity in non-ciliated neurons (Senti & Swoboda 2008)
Basonuclin/Disco; UNC-3 target required for maintenance of VA and VB motor neuron identity (Li 2020)
ALA + SIA selector (with ceh-14); Hobert 2016 map table
Posterior Hox; PLM touch + tail neuron identity (Hobert 2016 map)
TEAD-family; co-selector for FLP head touch neuron (with egl-46)
Zn-finger; co-selector for FLP head touch (with egl-44)
Daughterless/E; forms the HLH-2/HLH-4 terminal selector complex for ADL identity (Hobert & Kratsios 2019)
Terminal selector for ADL with HLH-2; continuously expressed (Hobert & Kratsios 2019)
MECOM; co-activator with fos-1 for synaptic genes
FOS; activity-induced; mutual feedback with egl-43
CUT family; co-binds with EGL-43/FOS-1 at synaptic promoters
CUT family; co-binds with EGL-43/FOS-1 at synaptic promoters
CUT family; pan-neuronal gene regulator; expression in PDE does not depend on EGL-43 (Yee 2024)
CUT family; pan-neuronal gene regulator; expression in PDE requires EGL-43 (Yee 2024)
Distal-less; activity-regulated cofactor (Yee 2024) AND terminal selector for dopaminergic neurons (Doitsidou 2013; Hobert 2016 map)
Pro-remodeling TF; DD GABA synapse remodeling
Anti-remodeling TF in VD GABAergic MNs
Ig-domain effector; anti-remodeling; downstream of UNC-30, repressed by IRX-1
FoxO; intersects with terminal selectors for innexin plasticity
Dauer master switch; nervous-system remodeling input
Heterochronic; required for presynaptic polarity of DA motor neurons (Armakola 2019)
Heterochronic Zn-finger TF; required for presynaptic polarity of DA motor neurons (Armakola 2019)
BK Ca-activated K channel; modulates remodeling output (Cuentas-Condori 2020)
Insulin/IGF-1 receptor; loss of insulin signaling in dauer activates daf-16, which induces dauer-specific innexin expression (Bhattacharya 2019)
TGF-beta ligand; DAF-7 signaling regulates GLR-1 glutamate receptor abundance (McGehee 2015) and chemoreceptor expression (Nolan 2002)
Neph1/2; instructs presynaptic assembly in HSN
Nephrin; SYG-1 ligand on vulval epithelia
Contactin; binds SAX-7/L1CAM to wire a sensory circuit (Kim 2017)
Netrin; secreted guidance + synapse cue (UNC-40 ligand)
Flamingo/CELSR; regulates GABAergic neuron synaptic development (Najarro 2012)
SLC17 putative sialic acid transporter; regulates synapse organization (Hendi 2019)
Rap2 GTPase; downstream of PLX-1, restricts synapse formation for tiling in DA9 (Chen/Mizumoto 2018)
Master AZ assembly factor; upstream of syd-2
RIM; SV localization to release sites
Clarinet; Piccolo/Bassoon homolog; recruits RIMB-1 + UNC-13
LAR receptor PTP; partners with SYD-2
Liprin-beta; regulates organization and function of neuromuscular junctions (Wang 2009)
STRADα pseudokinase; cooperates with SAD-1 to regulate neuronal polarity + synaptic organization (Kim/Zhen 2010)
